acceptance.item: Absent, zero and unaccounted are three different states, rendered three different ways, on one surface
acceptance.passDirection: src/finance-lens.test.mjs renders ONE surface holding all three: a measured zero renders as '0' with its source and the date it was read; an unaccounted source renders as the word 'UNACCOUNTED'; the absent fund list renders as no rows behind its honest-empty sibling. The test asserts the three renderings differ and that neither the zero nor the absence is rendered as the other.
acceptance.violationDirection: writing `value: 0` into the granted-but-unread branch of resolveSource -> 'AssertionError: adopted-budget / actual:  0 / expected:  UNACCOUNTED'
acceptance.foundByViolating: That violation failed NO test at first. The branch was unreachable off today's catalog, so it was dead code holding a live zero, and the module's own docstring claimed every branch was reachable and exercised. The fix was not to delete the branch - it is load-bearing the week opengov's shape is declared - but to give it a surface by declaring the shape for the test. Recorded in commit 38b53df.

acceptance.item: The fund ledger stays UNACCOUNTED and is never sourced from anywhere to fill it
acceptance.passDirection: Asserted on all four shipped packs (template-city, empty-city, fixture-city, bastrop_tx): state UNACCOUNTED, no value, basis naming the unmet acquisition path.
acceptance.violationDirection: granting the very kind the ledger names (opengov) -> still UNACCOUNTED, `value` undefined, basis matching /not declared on G-91/, and read === 0 with the assertion message 'a grant is not a reading'
acceptance.note: The fund table renders no rows at all rather than four zero rows, and the basis states why: the fund list is the adopted budget feed's own output and no reading of that feed exists.

acceptance.blockedBy: No DigitalOcean Apps credential in this session.

evidence.doAppsMcp: The `do-apps` MCP server reported namespaceStatus 'loading' on every one of four retries across the session and never exposed a tool beyond mcp_auth. The sibling `do-droplets` server on the same token answered normally (droplet-list returned d5-smartcity-dashboards, d5-smartcity-scraper, d5-smartcity-api), so the MCP channel is live and it is specifically the Apps server that did not come up.
evidence.doctl: doctl is installed but carries no token: 'Error: Unable to initialize DigitalOcean API client: access token is required.' No config exists at %APPDATA%\doctl, ~/.config/doctl, or %LOCALAPPDATA%\doctl, and no DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN is set. `doctl auth init` needs a token that this session does not hold.
evidence.preamble: _catalog/DISPATCH_PREAMBLE.md says doctl auth does not reliably carry over to every lane's session and that a lane should check it rather than assume, and it forbids asking the operator to reconfigure the MCP servers or the token. Checked, not assumed; not asked for.

leaveBehind: THE UAT READ-BACK IS NOT DONE AND IS THE ONE OPEN ITEM. d12-main-uat is serving bytes identical to its pre-merge baseline, so the merged build has not reached it, and this session could not deploy it (see acceptance.uat). Nothing about the merged code is in doubt; what is missing is the platform-level proof on the non-production app.

THE A11Y GATE CAUGHT WHAT REVIEW DID NOT, AND THE HOUSE HAD ALREADY PAID FOR IT. The first build drew the fund columns as a table with a thead and an empty tbody; axe's th-has-data-cells could not settle it and the gate refused all four Finance scans. The rule was already written in web/app.js above renderPropertyRecords() from the time it fired there. The empty state now comes first and the table body hides behind it, with the four cells still named on the page - which was the reason for drawing them.

scripts/bake-connections.mjs STILL FLATTENS CRLF. It has the same latent defect that bakeFinanceLensInto had: it normalises line endings on write, which for web/** would fight .gitattributes and produce a diff of the whole file. Found here, fixed in the Finance baker only, not touched in the connection baker because it is outside this lane.

check.mjs CHECKS TRACEABILITY, NOT PLACEMENT. A capture figure rendered outside a quotation passes, because it is still traceable to capture-figures.json. The quotation gate is asserted in src/finance-lens.test.mjs instead (capture is returned for bastrop_tx and for no other pack; the default document carries no money token at all). A future lane wanting the design instrument to catch placement needs a rule it does not have today.

THE CAPTURE RECORD ITSELF IS UNVERIFIED against anything but v1's own screens, and its caveat says so. This lane rendered it as a QUOTATION with the page and the v1 sentence attached, which is the strongest thing the record supports; it is not evidence that Bastrop's numbers are right.
